prompt.system:
You draft the after-call work for a commercial lines account manager at an insurance agency. You get the facts of the call as JSON. Every fact you need is there; use only those facts.

Write three drafts:
- activity_note: the note for the agency management system. Plain, factual, past tense, short lines. What the client asked, what was found, what the agent did and decided, what is open, the follow-up date.
- endorsement_request: to the carrier's underwriter, asking for each policy change in the facts, with the policy number and the reason (the contract requirement or the new location). One request, itemized.
- follow_up_email: to the client, from the agent, first names. Warm and brief. What happens next on the certificate, what was noted about the new location, and the professional liability information she asked for in writing, with the follow-up date.

Rules. These are regulated documents and a licensed agent will review them before anything is sent.
- Never say or imply that anything is covered, bound, or approved. Endorsements are requested, not in force. A certificate goes out only after the carrier confirms the endorsements.
- Never promise a date the facts don't give.
- Never quote, paraphrase or summarize disclosure text. Refer to a disclosure only by its name, and only to say when it is delivered or signed.
- No premium figures, no coverage advice, no legal advice.
- Sign the email with the agent's first name and the agency name. No placeholders in brackets.

activity_note.title: Call with Marisol Reyes, Reyes Design Build, Inc. - 10/29/2026
activity_note.body:
Date: 10/29/2026. Agent: Dana Whitfield. Contact: Marisol Reyes, owner.
Recorded-line notice delivered at start of call.

Request:
Certificate of insurance for Larchmont Property Group, needed before crew starts work Monday.

Findings - contract requirements vs. policy WBM-GL-4471902 (Westbrook Mutual):
- AI ongoing operations: on policy (CG 20 33).
- AI completed operations: not on policy; needs CG 20 37.
- Primary and noncontributory: not on policy; needs CG 20 01.
- Waiver of subrogation: Larchmont Property Group must be added to CG 24 04 schedule.
Certificate not issued. Certificate cannot show AI completed ops or primary/noncontributory until carrier confirms endorsements.

Changes since underwriting file:
- Design work now done in-house (file: no design work; subcontracts all electrical and plumbing).
- New location: yard in Vernon, since last month (file: one location, LA office).

Exposure review:
- Professional services (design, specifications, drawings) excluded from GL by CG 22 79.
- Agent confirmed recommendation: Contractors Professional Liability, non-admitted market.
- Quote requested from Harborline Specialty Insurance Co. and Meridian Surplus Underwriters. Nothing bound.

Actions:
- Started endorsement request to Westbrook Mutual during call: add CG 20 37, add CG 20 01, schedule Larchmont Property Group on CG 24 04, add Vernon yard location.
- California surplus lines disclosure (D-1) sent for signature.
- Broker fee disclosure delivered.

Client decision:
Wants professional liability information in writing; will review this weekend.

Open:
- Carrier confirmation of endorsements; certificate to follow only after confirmation.
- PL quotes pending.
- D-1 signature pending.

Follow-up: Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

endorsement_request.title: Endorsement Request - Reyes Design Build, Inc. - Policy WBM-GL-4471902
endorsement_request.body:
Westbrook Mutual Underwriting,

On behalf of our insured, Reyes Design Build, Inc., we request the following endorsements on Commercial General Liability policy WBM-GL-4471902:

1. Add CG 20 37 (Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Completed Operations). Reason: required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

2. Add CG 20 01 (Primary and Noncontributory - Other Insurance Condition). Reason: required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

3. Schedule Larchmont Property Group on CG 24 04 (Waiver of Subrogation). Reason: waiver of subrogation required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

4. Add location: yard in Vernon. Reason: new location leased by the insured last month.

Please confirm each item once processed so we can issue a certificate to Larchmont Property Group. The insured's crew is scheduled to start work Monday, so we appreciate your prompt review. Please let us know if you need any additional information.

Thank you,
Dana Whitfield
Pacific Crest Insurance Services

follow_up_email.title: Following up on today's call - Larchmont certificate and next steps
follow_up_email.body:
Hi Marisol,

Thank you for your time today. Here's a quick recap of where things stand.

Certificate for Larchmont Property Group: Your contract calls for a few items that aren't on your general liability policy yet, so I've sent a request to Westbrook Mutual to add them to policy WBM-GL-4471902: additional insured for completed operations (CG 20 37), primary and noncontributory (CG 20 01), and adding Larchmont Property Group to your waiver of subrogation schedule (CG 24 04). These are requested, not yet in place. I'll issue the certificate as soon as the carrier confirms the endorsements, and I'll let you know the moment I hear back.

New location: I noted your new yard in Vernon and included it in the same request to the carrier.

Professional liability: As you asked, here it is in writing. Because your team now handles design work in-house (design, specifications, drawings), that work is excluded from your general liability policy by endorsement CG 22 79. My recommendation is Contractors Professional Liability, which is placed in the non-admitted (surplus lines) market. I've requested quotes from Harborline Specialty Insurance Co. and Meridian Surplus Underwriters; nothing has been bound. I've also sent you the California surplus lines disclosure (D-1) for signature, and the broker fee disclosure was delivered.

Take your time with this over the weekend. I'll follow up with you on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

Best,
Dana
Pacific Crest Insurance Services
